fonte: Popular Science (reporter on board); Five Deeps Expedition release
nota: A data é da Popular Science, a bordo ("Wednesday, December 19"; o navio "needed to leave its post at 7 p.m. on Wednesday, December 19"; Vescovo passou de 7.100 m "early Wednesday afternoon"). O release da Five Deeps é de 21/12 (a data que a Wikipedia copia, N06) e diz "the first human to dive on a solo mission to the deepest point in the Atlantic" e "First manned descent to the verified bottom". Nunca "the first human at the bottom" (N03): o Archimède desceu na fossa em 1964.
